description.value: Peace Country Delite is a local coffee shop located in Fort St. John, in the heart of British Columbia's Peace Country region in the province's northeast. Situated on 100 Avenue, it serves as a stop for travellers passing through this hub community on the Alaska Highway corridor. Cyclists making their way through Fort St. John on long-distance routes would find it a convenient spot for a hot drink.
